detail: Same directions as vim, and as tmux panes.
Letters make good mnemonics: m for mail, s for slack.

description: Send the focused window to that workspace
detail: Same key you would use to go there, plus Shift.

description: Back to the workspace you came from
Tiles layout, toggling between horizontal and vertical
Accordion layout, for stacking windows you switch between
Shrink or grow the focused window
Move this whole workspace to the next monitor
Enter service mode, for the things you do rarely
detail: From there: Esc reloads the config, r resets the layout, f toggles floating, Backspace closes every window but this one, Alt+Shift+h j k l joins with a neighbour.

description: Up and down arrows in service mode change the volume
detail: Shift+Down mutes and drops you back to normal mode.
